name: Higurashi When They Cry: Mionkakushi
source:
Sonozaki Mion is just a simple country girl, trying to balance the demands of school, the obligations of family, and most importantly, staying one step ahead of everyone else in the Club. 

But as she prepares to make this the best Watanagashi Festival yet she is confronted by proof that not all is as it seems, and demons can sometimes wear the faces of friends…

Finally the time has come for Mion’s story to be brought into the light....
